description: GRUTA is a Mozambican innovation team passionate about AI, data science, space technology, and Earth observation. We are building TerraPulse AI to detect environmental trends using NASA satellite data. We welcome collaborators skilled in Python, GIS, remote sensing, climate science, statistics, web development, and UI/UX design. Curiosity and teamwork matter!
summary: TerraPulse AI is an AI-powered agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers in Mozambique identify the best time to start planting based on rainfall patterns. Aligned with NASA Space Apps Challenge's “Be An Earth System Trend Detective!”, it analyzes historical precipitation data to identify seasonal trends and changing rainfall patterns. Using a Random Forest machine learning model, it classifies upcoming planting conditions as favorable or unfavorable. By transforming Earth observation data into practical insights, TerraPulse AI aims to reduce uncertainty in planting decisions, support climate adaptation, and strengthen agricultural resilience and food security.
details:
TerraPulse AI is an AI-powered platform that helps farmers identify the best time to start planting by analyzing historical and recent rainfall patterns.

It uses precipitation data to identify seasonal trends and a Random Forest Classification model to predict whether planting conditions are favorable or unfavorable.

The project aims to reduce uncertainty in agricultural decisions, support climate adaptation, and improve food security, particularly in Mozambique.

Technologies include Python, Flask, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, and Earth observation and weather data sources.

Its innovation lies in transforming climate data into practical planting recommendations, making complex scientific information useful and accessible to farmers.
